title: 4.2 Crew Assignment
objective: Assign every operative to Team A or Team B so no adjacent vertices share a team, or report an odd-cycle conflict.
controls: Assign colour (A/B) to frontier vertices | [R] Run | [S] Step
start_status: Partition the 6-vertex contact graph into two conflict-free crews.
hints: This 6-cycle graph has only even cycles, so it is 2-colourable (bipartite).
An edge connecting two same-colour vertices proves non-bipartiteness.
